يتغابى (form VI)
# يَتَغَابَى (yataḡābā) /ja.ta.ɣaː.baː/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative/subjunctive of تَغَابَى (taḡābā)
# يُتَغَابَى (yutaḡābā) /ju.ta.ɣaː.baː/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative/subjunctive of تَغَابَى (taḡābā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
